display_name: Employment Rights Act 2025 (UK) under one top-level goal — statutory sick pay as amended (rate, no waiting days), the six-month unfair dismissal qualifying period, and guaranteed-hours complaint time limits with early conciliation — and those three goals

others: the weekly rate of statutory sick pay for (era25-rules.l4)
the first day statutory sick pay is payable for (era25-rules.l4)
the six-month qualifying period is met in (era25-rules.l4)
the last day to present the complaint for (era25-rules.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 10-11 (SSCBA ss 152-157, Sch 11 as amended), s 25 (ERA 1996 s 108 as amended), and ERA 1996 s 27BH as inserted by s 1, with ERA 1996 s 207B, of the revised text as at 1 July 2026. Left out on purpose: the guaranteed-hours duty itself, shifts, flexible working, leave, harassment, fire and rehire, collective redundancy, outsourcing, the Social Care Negotiating Body, trade unions, enforcement.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 63 assertions; 62 from expectations written before the encoding was read and one probe after). One fails by design: the tester would stop only the conciliation days falling before the original limit; the encoding stops all days from Day A to Day B once conciliation starts within the period (F5) — an open question for a lawyer. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: SSP weekly rate: lower of £118.75 and 80% of NWE; no LEL.
forks.F2: SSP payable from the first day of incapacity (no waiting days; qualifying days not checked).
forks.F3: Six months ending with the EDT: corresponding-date rule.
forks.F4: s 27BH periods begin the day after the trigger (8: the day of awareness).
forks.F5: s 207B(3): days from the later of Day A + 1 and the period start up to Day B are stopped, even past the original limit (the clock stops at Day A and restarts after Day B).
